title: Admin tour: what admins do
summary: Open the Admin area and see what each admin card is for.

steps.text: Log in with your admin account. Open the menu at the top left and tap 'Admin'. Only admins see this item.
'User Management' turns accounts off or on and makes admins. 'Feedback Management' and 'Feed Reports' show what all users have sent and saved.
'Feed Management' changes the shared feed library one feed at a time. 'Bulk Upload / Download / Delete' works on many feeds at once with an Excel file.
'Feed Library Sync' brings feeds in from the CLIMDES feed database. 'Country / Language' decides which countries appear in the app and which languages each country's users can pick.
The server checks your admin role on every change. Shared feeds and languages affect every user of a country, so check before you save.

problems.title: I don't see 'Admin' in the menu
problems.text: Your account is not an admin. Ask another admin to switch on 'Administrator Access' for you in 'User Management' (topic 1), then log out and log in again.

problems.title: 'Admin privileges required'
problems.text: Your admin role was taken away while you were logged in. Ask another admin to check your account.
